description: This file implements a C++ class 'RunCImplementation' and related classes for managing container lifecycle operations using the 'runc' runtime, including creating, executing commands, deleting, and querying container state. It defines classes for container configuration, state information, and a runner to interface with the 'runc' command-line tool, along with container administrator and container classes.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic to create, execute, delete, and query the state of containers using the 'runc' CLI, including handling configuration and environment inheritance.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Holds container process ID and status information, serializable to/from JSON.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents container configuration, including process environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for container process configuration.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via 'runc', providing methods to start, stop, and query container status.

classes.name: RunCContainer::InternalPurge
classes.description: Internal method to delete the container if it is running.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU usage info for the container.
